value.text:
The user wants me to act as Evidence Critic and check each claim against the cited evidence. I need to flag only factual problems: overstatements, wrong numbers/dates/suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence. Reasonable conclusions from cited facts are supported.

Let me examine each claim:

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 55150-438-10 is not on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [search-shortage-18]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA shortage list snapshot for our package NDC 55150-438-10 and product 55150-438: not on the list."

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock of 10 units covers only 2.3 days at 4.4 units per day." Cited: [stock-18]

Evidence says: "ketamine KETAMINE HYDROCHLORIDE 10 mg/mL (Eugia US LLC, NDC 55150-438-10, ANDA076092): 10 units on hand, 4.4/day over 30 days, 2.3 days of cover"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-18]

Evidence says: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 55150-438-10 and product 55150-438: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

All claims appear supported. No factual problems. So unsupported list empty.

I must reply with JSON: {"unsupported":[]}.</think>{"unsupported":[]}
